video.title: Aging Economy Structural Demographics and Capital Allocation

thesis_health.reason: Post-acute rehabilitation volume and chronic medtech resupply confirm sustained unit economics against stable labor costs.

scenarios.description: Medicare Advantage reimbursement rates expand >4%; clinical wage inflation falls below 2.5%; elective and post-acute volumes grow >8%.
entry_conditions: CMS Medicare Advantage rate benchmark increase > 4.0%

scenarios.description: CMS reimbursement updates track 2.5% to 3.2%; nursing wage growth stabilizes at 3.0% to 3.8%; organic procedural volume expands 4.5% to 6.5%.
entry_conditions: Inpatient prospective payment updates meet or exceed 3.0%
Contract agency labor stabilizes below 2.0% of operating expenses

scenarios.description: Persistent clinical staffing shortages drive contract agency spikes; severe Medicare Advantage denials; private-pay senior housing rent ceilings hit.
entry_conditions: Contract labor spikes above 5% of payroll
Reimbursement cuts across federal fee-for-service schedules
exit_conditions: Systemic provider restructuring or covenant breaches

decision.summary: Core structural demand remains pristine. Focus capital allocation strictly on cash-generative medtech and post-acute operators trading within margin of safety, while rejecting high-multiple REITs.
required_actions: Keep Welltower (WELL) on valuation hold pending multiple normalization

developments.title: ResMed Reports Robust FY2026 Performance with 59.1% Gross Margin
developments.fact: ResMed global revenue grew 9% YoY to $5.12B with Q4 gross margin expanding 140 bps to 59.1% and free cash flow conversion exceeding 95%.
developments.interpretation: Validates durable pricing power and software-driven compliance workflows that generate non-cyclical consumables cash flow.

developments.title: Encompass Health Same-Store Discharges Grow 5.2% in Q2 2026
developments.fact: EHC delivered 6.8% revenue growth to $1.34B and raised 2026 revenue guidance to $5.35B-$5.45B, keeping agency labor below 1.2% of salaries.
developments.interpretation: Confirms post-acute inpatient rehabilitation demand elasticity remains high while labor operational control preserves operating margins.

developments.title: CMS Finalizes FY2027 Inpatient Rehabilitation Facility Rate Increase of 3.0%
developments.fact: CMS established a net 3.0% market basket payment update for IRFs effective October 1, 2026, injecting an estimated $285M aggregate industry increase.
developments.interpretation: Eliminates near-term reimbursement downside risk and guarantees positive spread over anticipated wage inflation of 2.8%-3.2%.

developments.title: Stryker Orthopedic Volume Expands 9.0% Driven by Mako Installed Base
developments.fact: Stryker MedSurg & Orthopaedics delivered 9.0% organic sales growth with knee procedure growth exceeding 10.4% and international robotics expanding 14%.
developments.interpretation: Robotic surgical workflow integration establishes deep switching moats and predictable procedural implant utilization.

developments.title: Welltower Senior Housing Occupancy Reaches 86.8% at Premium Valuation
developments.fact: Welltower reported 21.4% same-store SHO NOI growth and 86.8% occupancy, while trading at >31.5x normalized FFO and >2.4x NAV.
developments.interpretation: Operational tailwinds are proven, but extreme valuation multiples provide no margin of safety for investment capital.

developments.title: Proposed CMS CY2027 Home Health Rule Imposes -1.8% Permanent Adjustment
developments.fact: CMS proposed a 2.7% market basket update offset by a 1.8% permanent behavioral rate cut, constraining net aggregate updates for home health to ~0.9%.
developments.interpretation: Broadens the competitive and economic moat of inpatient rehabilitation facilities relative to margin-squeezed home health agencies.

developments.title: Longitudinal Real-World Sleep Apnea Study Shows GLP-1 Adherence Synergies
developments.fact: Clinical registry tracking 15,000 patients demonstrated that GLP-1 usage increased sleep apnea diagnosis rates by 11% and improved PAP adherence by 4.2%.
developments.interpretation: Rebuts structural obsolescence fears for respiratory medtech, validating co-therapy compliance and market expansion.

scorecard.name: Demographic & Utilization Demand
scorecard.assessment: Accelerating growth in the 75+ age cohort supports non-elective procedure and rehabilitation volume.

scorecard.name: Funding, Reimbursement & Pricing Power
scorecard.assessment: Finalized CMS IRF update of +3.0% locks in positive spread over labor inflation; Medicare Advantage scrutiny remains active.

scorecard.name: Labor Scarcity & Productivity Demand
scorecard.assessment: Contract labor has subsided to historical lows (<1.5%), but baseline clinical nursing wage growth of 3.0%-3.5% requires productivity tools.

scorecard.name: Decentralized & Tech-Enabled Delivery
scorecard.assessment: Cloud compliance platforms and robotic-assisted surgical ecosystems entrench provider stickiness and expand operating margins.

scorecard.name: Chronic Demand & Mission-Critical Need
scorecard.assessment: Joint wear, stroke neurological deficits, and sleep-disordered breathing represent non-discretionary care with strong recurring demand.

scorecard.name: Provider Quality, Moats & Regulatory Trust
scorecard.assessment: Certificate-of-need barriers, specialized hospital accreditation, and proprietary medtech patents insulate incumbents from capital disruption.

catalysts.name: CMS FY2027 IRF PPS Implementation
catalysts.confirmation_test: Net reimbursement yield increases by >= 2.8% on Q4 billing cohorts.
catalysts.failure_test: Billing realization falls below 2.0% due to administrative offsets.

catalysts.name: Q3 2026 Post-Acute & Medtech Earnings Cycle
catalysts.confirmation_test: Same-store discharge growth > 4.5% and organic medtech sales growth > 8.0%.
catalysts.failure_test: Organic discharge growth decelerates below 2.0% or agency labor spikes.

catalysts.name: CY2027 Home Health Final Rule Issuance
catalysts.confirmation_test: Net market basket update confirmed between 1.0% and 1.8%.

publication.headline: Aging Demographics Reaffirm High-Moat Medtech & Inpatient Operators Over Stretched REIT Valuations
publication.summary: Weekly thematic scan confirms robust post-acute discharge volumes and high recurring consumables margins, highlighting entry points in ResMed and Encompass Health while rejecting overvalued senior living REITs.
